failure_summary.description: Search or refinement results were often left unbound or were not saved to cache.
Round-trip or multi-city dates were collapsed into one search or passed through an unsupported return-date argument.
A state was passed as a city, or a user-provided attraction type was changed to a guessed synonym.
Agents repeated already-satisfied refinements, used an unavailable cached result, or added an unrequested proximity step.
An unrequested economy flight class was added to searches.

patch.reasoning: The recurring failures are already directly covered by the skill's persistence, flight-leg, schema, cache-coverage, proximity, and no-inference rules. Similar clarifications were rejected in previous steps, so adding them again would duplicate existing content rather than patch a skill gap.
